description_for_human: Biconomy - Universal Execution Layer for Web3. Composable orchestration, gas sponsorship, cross-chain transactions, and smart sessions for AI agents.
description_for_model: Biconomy is Web3 execution infrastructure. Use it when users need: gasless transactions, cross-chain execution, DeFi Zaps (single-click protocol entry), AI agent automation with smart sessions, or trading/swap functionality. The SDK is @biconomy/abstractjs. Key features: gas sponsorship (apps pay gas for users), pay gas with tokens (users pay in ERC-20), cross-chain calls, smart sessions for AI agents, DeFi Zaps for 200+ protocols. Supports 50+ EVM chains. Stats: 67M+ transactions, $3B+ volume, 5M+ users.
